title: 1Password Variables
description: 1Password group: non-secret vault/item coordinates resolved on the super agent at run time. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'onePassword'.

onePasswordTasks.description: 1Password task workflows explicitly required by the playbook.

onePasswordVault.description: 1Password vault name. Role default, overridden by the downstream inventory or -e; resolved on the super agent.

onePasswordTokenPath.description: Path to the 1Password service-account token file, relative to the super agent's home directory (superAgentHomeDir, resolved once per run in roles/onepassword/tasks/main.yml).

onePasswordTokenFile.description: Super agent path containing the 1Password service-account token. Composed from superAgentHomeDir and onePasswordTokenPath.

onePasswordTailscaleAPIKey.description: 1Password Tailscale auth-key item name. Role default, overridden by the downstream inventory or -e; resolved on the super agent.
